name: Product Variant Price System
description:
The Product Variant Price System module in Odoo helps businesses manage pricing for product variants based on attribute values. This module supports both fixed extra price adjustments and percentage-based coefficients, allowing flexible and dynamic pricing strategies.  

    **Key Features:**  
    1) **Attribute-Based Pricing:**  
       - Define variant prices based on attributes for automated pricing adjustments.  

    2) **Multiplicative Adjustments:**  
       - Modify product prices dynamically using percentage-based variations.  

    3) **Dynamic Variant Management:**  
       - Automatically adjust variant prices based on attribute changes.  

    4) **Instant Sale Price Adjustments:**  
       - The sale price updates in real-time based on attribute settings.  

    5) **Compatibility Across Odoo Modules:**  
       - Seamlessly integrates with Odoo Sales, E-commerce, and Point of Sale (POS).  

    6) **Advanced Pricing Formula:**  
       - Calculate final prices based on a structured formula, combining fixed extra prices and coefficient-based variations.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **E-commerce & Online Stores:** Set dynamic pricing for configurable products based on customer selections.  
    - **Manufacturing & Custom Orders:** Automate pricing adjustments based on raw material costs and product variations.  
    - **Retail & Wholesale:** Offer custom pricing structures based on attributes such as size, color, and features.

    - **Navigation:** Product → Attributes & Variants → Configure Attribute Price  
    - **Navigation:** Sales → Product Configurator → Set Variant Pricing  
    - **Navigation:** Inventory → Products → Define Extra Pricing

name: Multi website selection for products | Multiple Websites per Category | Bulk website assign | Product Multiple Website
description:
The Multiple Websites per Product & Category app in Odoo allows users to assign multiple websites to both products and categories, overcoming the limitation of a single-website selection. By default, all products and categories appear on every website, but this module provides the flexibility to display selected products or categories only on specific websites. Additionally, a mass update feature enables bulk website assignments, improving productivity and saving time.  

    **Key Features:**  
    1) **Select Multiple Websites:**  
       - Assign multiple websites to a product or category instead of just one.  

    2) **Mass Update Website Assignments:**  
       - Quickly update multiple products and categories with website assignments.  

    3) **Hide Products on Unselected Websites:**  
       - Products are displayed only on assigned websites. If no website is selected, the product appears by default.  

    4) **Hide Categories on Unselected Websites:**  
       - Categories are displayed only on assigned websites. If no website is selected, the category appears by default.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **eCommerce & Marketplace:** Show specific products only on designated websites for different target audiences.  
    - **Multi-Brand Stores:** Manage product and category availability across multiple brands or regional websites.  
    - **B2B & B2C Sales Management:** Assign different product catalogs to different business units or customer groups.  

    **Supported Views:**  
    - **Navigation:** Website → Products → Website Assignment  
    - **Navigation:** Website → Categories → Website Assignment  
    - **Navigation:** Website → Mass Update → Assign Websites

name: Product Multi Barcode For Enterprise
description:
The Product Multi Barcode For Enterprise app enables Odoo users to assign multiple barcodes to each product for better tracking and management. It ensures efficient product identification across various sales, purchase, and stock operations, improving workflow efficiency. The app also prevents barcode duplication errors when assigning barcodes.  

    **Key Features:**  
    1) **Multi Barcode for Each Product:**  
       - Assign multiple barcodes to a single product for better identification.  

    2) **Product Search Using Multi Barcode:**  
       - Locate products in sales, purchases, invoices, and stock operations using any assigned barcode.  

    3) **Duplicate Barcode Restriction:**  
       - Prevent barcode duplication across products by enabling the "Is Multi Barcode Unique" setting.  

    4) **Barcode Scanning in Operations:**  
       - Scan and select products in sale orders, purchase orders, invoices, stock pickings, and inventory operations.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **Retail & POS:** Quickly scan products using multiple barcodes at checkout.  
    - **Warehouse Management:** Improve inventory tracking and stock picking efficiency.  
    - **Sales & Purchase Orders:** Easily find and add products using any associated barcode.  

    **Supported Views:**  
    - **Navigation:** Inventory → Products → Barcode Tab  
    - **Navigation:** Sales → Orders → Order Lines  
    - **Navigation:** Stock → Operations → Barcode Scanning

With this app, organizations can establish a hierarchical structure for their sales teams, assigning parent-child relationships to define clear access levels and responsibilities.  

    **Key Features:**  
    1) **Parent-Child Relationship:**  
       - Create a hierarchical structure within sales teams, ensuring better organization and role distribution.  

    2) **Record Visibility:**  
       - Parent team members can access and manage sales records of child team members, improving oversight and tracking.  

    3) **New Access Rights for Team Leader:**  
       - Introduces a new access right, "Team Leader: Team Documents," allowing controlled data access within teams.  

    4) **Restricted Sales Record Access:**  
       - Team leaders can only view and manage their own team's records, preventing unauthorized access to other sales teams' data.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **Sales Team Management:** Easily organize sales teams with clear hierarchy and defined responsibilities.  
    - **Access Control for Sales Data:** Restrict sales order visibility to the respective teams, enhancing data security.  
    - **Efficient Supervision:** Parent teams can monitor child team performance and ensure sales targets are met.  

    **Supported Views:**  
    - **Navigation:** Settings → User (Assign Team Leader Group)  
    - **Navigation:** Sales → Configuration → Sales Team (Manage sales team hierarchy)  
    - **Navigation:** Sales → Quotations (View sales orders based on access rights)  
    - **Navigation:** Sales → Configuration → Sales Team (Assign parent teams)
